text: Greek salad was good, but the sub was disappointing.  Not much to it.  It was all bread and no flavor.

Love this place..when in doubt I always run by to Street Side grab a tofu Bahn mi and chicken spinach dumplings. Never go wrong with it and is perfect meal for my appetite. Accepting credit card, cash and venmo. Would highly recommend to order ahead of time by calling in as the orders could take a while.

This is a classic example of a "where the locals eat" restaurant. They have the freshest / best tasting fried chicken, cheese burgers, and ice cream! Young's has been around for quite awhile, and continues to serve great food! Their catering is top notch as well. So glad to have Young's in the neighborhood!!!

Okay been coming here for years now and I can honestly say this place is simple buy very delicious. The fact that your food is always fresh is amazing. Texture of the strips and the flavor is always on point. I usually get the box combo but take out the slaw for an extra piece of that delicious texas toast. And one get me started how good the sauce is. You can basically dip anything in there and it'll prolly be good. Maybe even ice cream.lol. But yeah canes is prolly one of my go tos here in town and honestly this place is delicious. And also service is A1 here also.

This business is doomed.

I ordered in the drive thru, got to the window, paid, and got a bag. When I asked for sauces, I was told that they don't give sauces with the combo meals - they charge 25¢. This is a poor business decision, but fine; I want sauces. Two sauces cost me 54¢. I asked the cashier about this policy and about the reactions that she's gotten from other customers. A woman who I believe is the manager came over, and she explained that they only give sauce when you buy boneless wings or tenders. "I got tenders. Well, I should have gotten tenders." I didn't get tenders. The cashier rang it up wrong. So I was charged more for bone-in chicken and charged more for sauce. The manager gave me exactly one dollar for the difference in price between bone-in chicken and tenders. I have no idea if that's right. She gave me 27¢ for one of the sauces. They give one sauce with the tenders combo, and so still charged me for one sauce. This took seven minutes. They burned more in payroll dealing with this than they charged for the sauce. 

I'm so frustrated that I can't even eat this.

If I feel inspired later, I'll add more stories of previous bad experiences here.

Edit to add: On a previous visit, the drive-thru line was about five cars deep. After some minutes of not moving, we parked and went inside to order. We found out the reason the drive-thru wasn't moving was that their headsets didn't work. I went outside, and that one poor guy had been sitting at the speaker box f

Went here for the first time on a rainy Sunday and got the breakfast bowl. Super cozy and the food was sublime. Sean was our server and rocked it. 

Pro tip: the hot sauce is the hottest thing that has ever touched my tongue. Use with caution.
Came here to watch a hockey game...awesome service and drinks and food super reasonable. Definitely recommend if you want to go somewhere off the strip that has a good atmosphere!!
I absolutely love this place. The food is amazing!! I am in love with the bento boxes. I definitely recommend this. The prices are amazing.

So I was going to come here for the first time and was disappointed because the hostess didn't try to accommodate us at all. I was trying to put us on the waitlist and she said "well just to let you know it's going to be like 3 hours until people leave." She then proceeded to tell me to look at the bar to see if there's anything open, so we did and nothing was open. I went back to hostess to put us on the waitlist and she said , "well it's going be a long wait like 3 hours."and I was like well can you just put us on the waitlist anyways instead of just saying NO to me. She was like "well I'm just letting you know." Well guess what we left and they called us back in like 10 minutes not 3. We had already left but you see this is unacceptable to dismiss a customer like that. Not happy one bit. Train your hostesses better please.

One day we wanted to find a new place so we started searching and this place was on top of the results so we decided to drive there and try their burgers.
The place was pretty busy when we got there.
The staff was pretty friendly and helpful and I learned later that the person who took our order was actually the owner.
They came to our table two times to make sure everything is good and we are satisfied with the food.
The food was really good and we enjoyed the quality, the taste and the way the food was served.
The place was pretty clean and well maintained and I can say that's probably my number one burger restaurant in Edmonton.
We have tried 5 different burgers so far and 4 milkshakes 
They were all awesome and very delicious.
I definitely recommend this place and I can't wait to see they open a new location in downtown area!

I love that this place is BYOB although I didn't get a chance to take advantage! Service was great and the menu was extensive. I got the veggie cheese steak but they were out of vegan cheese so I got regular cheese (fine for me but stunk for my friend who is a vegan) and it was pretty good. The fries were subpar but overall a yummy meal.
Kay was great! The seafood platter was amazing! Great prices beautiful view cool place !

We had the Kobe burgers, and they did not disappoint. Great options to build your own. Flavorful sauces. 

Though the prices here are a bit steep ($40 for two burgers and 2 sides), the burgers really are that good, and the portions are pretty big. We could've easily shared just one side. 

Loved the onion strings. Going against popular opinion, the truffle fries not so much. I look forward to trying some of the other options from that part of the menu.

Overall, this place is a little bit out of the way for me, but I'd definitely go back for what is surely one of the better burgers in the area.

Small, unassuming little spot in the West Philly neighborhood, with dishes that pack big flavor. 

I was so happy to see that Daleng is open amidst the pandemic - the perfect spot to continue supporting neighborhood businesses, while simultaneously getting your Southeast Asian food fix on. 

The shrimp summer rolls are my favorite - light, fresh, and served with the yummiest peanut dipping sauce. 
The Singapore Mei Fun is another staple - the noodle/protein combo is filling, without being too heavy. 

You really can't go wrong with any of the dishes at Daleng, especially for the price point. 
And if you can't swing by in person to pick up your food, there's the added bonus that they deliver via GrubHub.
This place is so good. Fair price, tasty food, fast. I always get the chicken korma, but the lunch buffet is great as well.
Best pork chop in the world. Cornbread and asparagus point. Roomy atmosphere. Great for winter meal. Would make 200 mile trip just to come back here
Tia was FANTASTIC!! Made our experience so much fun! Tacos were delicious and loved my passion fruit margarita!
This place rocks. Good service, great food, and view from the top deck is awesome. Give them a shot and you won't be disappointed.

Every WOW this little place has gotten is so well-deserved.  The Barbacoa tacos were delicious.  One caveat to all who want to indulge in excellent food...go EARLY!  We got there around 1130am and were able to grab a table.  Fifteen minutes later, the line stretched out the door!

I thought this place was pretty good, but not amazing. I'd come back, but only at the suggestion/desire of someone else.
I had the tin roof (pulled pork), chicken, Baja shrimp, and brisket tacos. It was enough that I couldn't eat more than a bite of the 4th.
The pork was soooo spicy I couldn't eat all of it, but great flavor. This one was my favorite of the 4. The chicken was fine, but also spicy and my mouth was still burning from the porks the Baja shrimp is a skip altogether- shrimp were rubbery and lacked flavor. The brisket was good, I liked it, but wouldn't rave about it. The best of all? The chips and salsa- totally bomb.
Overall, worth stopping at, you may like it better than me.

Really liked this bar. We stumbled upon it for lunch when looking on honky tonk row for a spot to catch some live music and eat some good food. 

The spot had the least amount of people waiting outside, so that's why we chose this spot. Glad we did, cause the food was really good and the drinks were decent too and pretty fairly priced. 

We ended up getting a few rounds of drinks, had a nice buzz, listened to the live band that was playing and ate some really surprisingly good bar food. 
The waitress was really good to and quick when we needed extra napkins, more food, and another round of drinks. 

Prob the best spot we went to when in Nashville.

This place sucks. I know they are supposed to be "dicks" but they take it to it to the next level by giving you very limited alcohol in your expensive drinks, taking over an hour and a half to get food delivered, and completely ignoring you the entire time you're there. Service sucks and their food sucks even more. It got to the point we were walking up to the bar to order drinks for ourselves because our waitress just never came to the table. Don't waste your time, there's so many other places to spend too much money in Nashville.
We had a lovely Dockside Delivery lunch to our boat today, which helped break up our quarantine routine! Everything was just as fresh and delicious as usual

I'm changing my rating because I got food poisoning from the cole slaw. After vomiting 24 hours almost it took the er 9 hours to get me where I could be released. So if you go here get was fried and no Mayo.

I just picked up my husbands and Is breakfast this morning. After waiting almost 20 minutes longer than expected, I get home to open my food (I ordered the eggs Benedict). There was literally no egg on my eggs Benedict. My husbands scrambled eggs looked like someone's leftover eggs. The food was cold. We live 2 minutes down the road. We will no longer be returning here, and will not recommend to any of our friends. Oh and every single time I've tried to call the restaurant, it goes straight to voicemail, the voicemail box is full.

I am a health care worker in Delaware County, and in these trying times, Clam Tavern's steak special with crab has really gotten me through some tough days. I came here for my birthday with a group of coworkers and was absolutely blown away by the steak special and baked clams. So much so that I went back numerous times in the following months. Once I picked up clams and tried really hard to refrain from eating them on my drive home. Of course I couldn't resist, so instead I told myself I would eat one clam at each red light. Spoiler, the clams didn't make it home. I would say this place really is a hidden gem, I've been telling all my philly friends about it, and I will say with certainty it is worth the trip and extra gas money.

This was the last part of our road trip my girlfriend loved it. The staff was kind and attentive... the drinks were on point . Thank you, I'd have pictures but we went through the food like scavengers .... appreciate you guys.

LOVE the food! The Tips are always falling off the bone. Tender, Just the way I like them!! The greens are seasoned and a must have side dish. Oh, and don't forget the peach cobbler for dessert! I wish it were bigger so we could dine in. It's essentially a carry out location. Good eats!

We went there on a Saturday night while visiting my sister and the place was amazing.  All of the staff are so friendly and welcoming, they even gave our 2 year old a mango lassi sample.  We ordered way too much food, but enjoyed it all and the leftovers heated up very well.  My favorite dishes were the samosa chaat and the tandori tikka kabobs.  Both the plain and the garlic naan were very fresh and complimented our food.  I loved how they accommodated our spice levels so our daughter could also try the foods. We would definitely stop there again when we are in the area!
Tek kelimeyle Harika  lezzetli yemekler tatmadıysanız tercihimiz paprica Grill sizleri bekliyoruz

Your pizza is great and the staff is wonderful.  My family and I are from the Bronx and for us, it is the closest for us from being home. Thank you and we will visit again. We will recommend your establishment to others to eat
Love there wings but the wait time is horrible. And I hear they use to better back in the day. But they taste pretty good to me. I get the Chili Wings.

The best place to get burritos in the SB/Goleta area. I always get the black bean and rice burrito and it is so yummy!  The customer service is also great and the food is quick even when it's rush hour. Good vegetarian options as well!
Hi. The chicken wings are excellent. Can't wait to try the Pizza next time. The deep fried mushrooms and mozzarella sticks not so good. They tasted plain. Needs spices like garlic powder etc.
This is a great place and the food is very tasty and healthy. What could be better than that! The owner is very friendly and I will be coming back here for lunch.
Pizza is awesome and it's non commercial pizza. Had a small antipasto salad too. It was good, just make sure you ask for more dressing. 1 pack not enough. Staff was very helpful.

Place was great! Went twice in two days and the pizza was amazing (and this is coming from someone who served pizza at their wedding)! Perfelt Neapolitan pizza with amazing crust and fired up in a gorgeous wood fired oven. Drinks were well prepared as well.

17 days ago I posted a review discussing my very bad experience at this location. You will see a note from Ford's Garage asking me to leave a comment on the Ford Garage website. I did as requested. However, no one has yet to reach out to me.i hope this is not some sort of game being played.

Waitress, Maria, was fantastic! She made our night. Food was ok but nothing spectacular. Caesar salad was our fave...hubby had catch of the day and it was good. Them Asian sauce and noodles made the dish. I had fish that was recommended with rice and white sauce and didn't care for it. It was fishy tasting. Drinks were ok, nothing special.  All in all I wouldn't recommend except for the service and sun set view.  Prices are high but we knew that ahead of time and didn't mind as we though the fppdmwould be worth it... it wasn't.

How things have changed in a bit over a year! Tonight my party sat for 45 minutes without receiving the appetizer we ordered. The person assigned to "wait" on us walked by at least 7 or 8 times and never thought to stop and inform us of how the order was progressing. How long does it take to cook & serve Pot Stickers?   

What once was among the best restaurants at The Village is now a shell of itself. The food that was coming out looked like the quality is subpar now and the "service" at least tonight was nonexistent. There's a Chick-Fil-A around the corner, I'd recommend going there over Kona Grill, at least you'll get service with a smile.

Never Going Back Again ($1 to Lindsey Buckingham).

My boyfriend and I were greeted nicely at the door and were sat shortly after. We waited about 5 minutes with some bread(no butter though) for our server. Caitlyn came up and began our experience- she was nice and professional but could've used a little more warmth in her service. After we placed our order we had endless bread rolls and our drinks never hit empty. My filet was perfectly cooked medium as was my boyfriend's medium rare 16oz ribeye. The sides were delicious and we spent $52 for the two of us the environment was clean and not too loud for 5 o' clock on a Tuesday. Overall we had a nice night out and had some yummy food- would recommend for date night

I was looking for a place that had fried whole belly clams and we discovered this gem of a seafood restaurant. We started with fried green tomatoes that were absolutely delicious. Hot, freshly made and the batter was so good. The hush puppies are so good you will want to eat them all. So look at this delicious plate of fried clams yummy!! Hubby had snow crab and stone crab that was a healthy serving and sooo good. I highly recommend this spot.

We loved going to home plate. I understand covid. What I dont understand is rudeness. Went with my kids and grandkids. Paid for batting. Balls kept running out. Bartender kept saying she was to busy. There were 2 bartenders. Maybe 10 people at bar. We bought drinks, food. Spent some good money. They were not that busy. Our reason for going was for kids. Batting cages. If you cant sustain them then close them. We called and even asked if they were open. Bartenders were so rude. Too busy talking to there friends. We used to love it. Not anymore

We have been going here FOR YEARS! But I have failed to do a review. First, the food is so good. We have had it for dinner, catering for confirmation classes and, honestly, was our first COVID delivery. Second, the customer service is phenomenal. I am a horrible customer. I am the one who calls the morning of confirmation class and asks if we can get dinner for 25 or the person I was tonight where I placed an order on-line for pick-up when I thought it was for delivery. Francesca called to let me know it was ready and I realized my mistake. She had EVERY right to make me come or even feel bad. Nope, instead, it was "no problem, I will send a driver."

Amazing food and class acts to the worst of customers!
Delicious food and awesome atmosphere! Potatoes and pickle fries were amazing. Our waiter was really nice too.
The food is great but it is a small amount for the price. The menu is overly complicated if you want pasta.  Staff makes up for some of the deficiencies of the restaurant.

Do NOT go here - the staff make your food right in front of you NOT wearing gloves! Disgusting! Choose the Washington twp or Glassboro location instead.. I have shared this with friends that have tried it again and they again wore no gloves, so this is a consistent problem.

Mmm mmm mmm! The service was fast and the food was sooo delicious! 5 Stars 

We entered into the restaurant and looked around confused, there were only 5 tables... but then the hostess lead us up stairs to the building next door and we entered into the full blown restaurant.

To start, we ordered the Sambosa sampler (8 pieces) that came with a tasty and spicy chimmichurri sauce. Then yogurt with cucumber dip, cucumber tomato salad and the eggplant dip. All were truly spectacular!

I then had a bowl of the Ash. It was a little funnier than traditional ash and had a clear broth, but all the flavor! 

For our main course we ordered the chicken Biriyani, quabuli pollo with lamb, and the chicken tikki Masala and Koobideh kabob combo. All 3 were excellent, but my favorite was the chicken biriyani!! It was sooo flavorful and quite frankly the best I've ever had!! 

I strongly recommend Sameems!
The food is always fresh and great ! Very good place to eat. The owner is very sweet and pleasant
Was trying to order food for 7 people right at 1030/1040 and they are not open. Their hours are wrong. Not cool for people on a time crunch

This was our first time here. If the crowd had not shown me where to enter, I'm not sure I would have found the entrance easily. It seems like a back entrance, and is not well marked. It was a busy Sunday morning, and the wait for a table was about 15 minutes. Coffee is pricey, but you can serve yourself from a variety of choices. 

Menu has many interesting things I'd like to try next time. Lunch looked as good as breakfast! Our meals were very filling; neither of us finished. I liked the fries more than my " fried potatoes" that came with my breakfast. They would not allow a substitution for one side for another in the breakfast combos.
Staff is friendly but busy.

In a time of great uncertainty, there are few things we can count on.  

One thing that is always consistent is the quality of Empty Bowl(especially the Khao Soi) 

It is truly one of the most flavorful, comforting, delicious dishes in Santa Barbara. 

Thank you

All the yes. My boyfriend and I agreed this is one of, if not, the best spots in Indy. The wings, smoked to perfection, the brisket, nice and crispy on the exterior and juicy inside. We're big side fans and the Mac and cheese and beans were phenomenal. We'll skip the potato salad next time! Food couldn't have been better but then you add in the ambience and perfect patio and it easily earns 5 stars. We can't wait to return!
The food is great with plenty of classic Greek choices and much more. The waiter was very helpful and outgoing.  Highly recommend this place. I will definitely be back!

Excellent shrimp po boy here! $16 for a large. Perfect ratio of shrimp to dressing, which consists of mayo, lettuce, pickles and hot sauce. Nice crusty bread with a bit of a bite, which I prefer. They recently reopened so it's take out only. Order and pay at the side door and then pick up at the front door. I visited on a Saturday when they open at 11AM. I arrived a few mins before opening and there were a steady stream of customers after me as it's popular with both locals and visitors.

The food was very good.  Service was definitely off though.  First, the wrong brands of beer were brought to ALL of us.  We felt bad because the bottles were already open so we  drank them instead of what we  ordered.  Service was fast...TOO FAST!  The problem was, all of our courses  arrived at one time!  Five minutes after our calamari appetizer arrived, our salads did as well.  We had just started to  enjoy our salads & the main courses were there!  Bad timing.  

Pretty sure we would have enjoyed the food more  if it had been spaced properly.   We may give this place another shot because the food WAS good & the portions were generous.  Maybe the servers are used to  serving just pizza instead of dinners...not sure what happened.

I lived near Humboldt Park in Chicago for a very long time. Jibarito Y Mas in Logan Square was my favorite Jibarito. I love Puerto Rican rice, Bacalaitos, Pastelitos, and on and on. I was really excited when I moved across the street from Alpha Brewing and Plantain Girl was here... then, a couple weeks later, I went to try the food and they were gone. Sadness. So, when I heard the news that this place was opening I knew I had to get there ASAP. I came opening weekend. Food was pretty alright, inside atmosphere was pretty meh (a little cooler up top I guess). Cool photos on the walls at least, and a cool old building. I'd love to see the Jibarito covered in garlic and oil on top, maybe a chicken option.. or stewed steak (bistec en salsa (my favorite)) option. In addition to the Jibarito, I also tried the La Tripleta (tasty and huge), Empenada (that dough! yum), Pernil (good), and Ropa Vieja (good). I'd definitely come back, and really hope they expand their menu out a bit and fully find their groove. I'd love to update to a 5 next time I come in.
Can't go wrong with Mexican. This food is top notch ! It is also in a great area !! Love love love it

We ate at Galatoire's 33 Bar and Steak while visiting NOLA for a St Patrick's Day.  It's connected to Galatoire's, but it's a separate, more casual restaurant.  We were seated on a Friday afternoon which I highly recommend.  The place is hopping, and the atmosphere is exciting.  The professionals of NOLA flock here on a Friday after a hard week so it's loud, crowded and serving up delicious food.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
Just had the best pork chop ever. Service was excellent and we totally enjoyed the experience. Don't pass this place by. Staff was great

Beer towers and food. Drake's offers dozens of different towers and appetizers that are perfect for a group of 6. 

Only down side.. there are not enough TV's in the back portion of this bar. Covid protocols aside (plastic wrap around each booth), most people don't have a clear view to a TV. There are about four or five 36" TV's in the back. Need more and bigger.

We've been keeping an eye on Dr BBQ for awhile now.  Tonight we finally made the trek over from our part of town. 

We were a party of 5 and seated after a brief wait. We stood in the entryway and were very entertained watching all the food the kitchen put up on the line. 

Everyone at the table ordered a variety of foods so we could try lots of dishes. 

Hands down the ribs were the fan-favorite. Pulled pork was the runner up. Also tried pork brisket, beef brisket and sausage. 

The sides were sadly all just meh.  The hot dishes were cold and cold dishes were lukewarm. We are big fans of bbq beans and we all agreed while the bean combo presented well, they lacked flavor. based on the servers suggestion, also tried- Mac and cheese, potato salad, collards, purple slaw, blue cheese slaw and fries. None were homeruns. 

Service was super speedy. The sauces are impeccable! Our table polished off a full bottle of sweet sauce.

Not sure I would drive over just for dinner again. However, if I was headed to the Trop I would likely give it another try.

One of my favorite things about Loco Pez is: the tacos are charged by the taco. I love mix and matching and trying a variety, and I have yet to eat one I do not like.

If you are going for brunch, do yourself a favor and order the TOTchos. You will thank me, and for that I say you're welcome. They are everything you need when eating brunch, even an egg. I'd say it's perfect for 2-4 people depending on how much other food you plan on ordering. 

The red and green rice is just something so new and different. Rice is easy to make at home, but when you're out to eat you want something special, and that is exactly what it is, special! 

Looking for gluten free options? They are made on corn tortillas and can guide you towards which taco options are okay for you. Yes, they have vegan options as well. 

Happy eating!

I was so pleased with our breakfast at Baja Cafe! The waitstaff was prompt and polite, and greeted us at the door/said goodbye when we left, which is always appreciated. We both had the Black Widow Benedict and it was so delicious. It was a lot of food and we easily could have split the plate. The hashbrowns were done to perfection (and we are picky about our hashbrowns)! They were crispy and golden on the outside and soft on the inside. I also enjoyed their coffee - it wasn't super weak like is commonly a problem with breakfast spots, but was also not too strong. Also of note, they have a pet friendly patio, which is great to know for the future. The only thing I would change would be their music... it's a little too loud for a breakfast spot and doesn't have broad appeal. But otherwise we will definitely be returning, with plans to try other types of eggs Benedict.

I have to admit, Ford's Garage was definitely magnificent. It's kind of the place to go in this neighborhood. It is so very good, yum yum. The crew was extremely pleasant and service is terrific. Going back to Ford's Garage.
So yummy! I don't know what they put in their ketchup but holy cow that stuff was delicious! Also, their yucca fries are amaaazing

The burg has best wings in town. Staff are great. All around great  Don't be surprised by the appearance and they have indoor and outdoor seating. Great prices good food. Try mama's homemade lemon soup excellent.

My husband and I enjoyed a wonderful breakfast. Love that they have espresso style coffee. The huge pancake was totally awesome. My husband enjoyed his crab cakes beenie. Didn't have much of a wait from the time we ordered to receiving our order. We will be back.

So yummy! I wanted to try something new so I picked Indian. This was a great choice! The potato pockets were amazing! The Lamb Tikki Masala on medium spice level was perfect. We will definitely order from there again. Reasonable price also.
Nice place but overly priced . I ordered the fish tacos and was disappointed. For $16 I got two tacos and a bunch of potatoes . I know times are hard but the food needs to be worth the money

Oh man, I loved this place. I've been to custom pizza chains before and it's a great concept, but Blaze Pizza and co ain't got nothing on these guys. They have a great selection of toppings from the classic choices like pepperoni & sausage, to more unique options like egg, goat cheese, and hot honey. I don't think I ever had goat cheese on a pizza before, it really made the flavor pop. I killed my pie quick. 

Also they make their own soft drinks and it's not good, they're gonna cause me to become addicted to soda again. That berry lemonade, the sweet pear drink, even the cereal milk cream soda... yo.

I'm happy to learn they have a couple of locations in NY, cause I'll definitely be through again.

Me and my friends went to this place. The food was...... not good. Down right nasty. Then the waitress who didn't do anything, out right said my friend needed to tip, after getting little to no service. Me and my friends ALWAYS TIP, but not that day.

We had a very nice dinner on the patio, it was a cool evening but they turned on the patio heaters right away for us, the server was very courteous, limited menu because of covid, but the tacos were very good, and they brought out chips two types of salsas' and delicious bean dip, I ordered a michelada w/ Pacifico beer and it was delicious, my husband ordered the house margarita and commented that it was a weak one and the mix wasn't the greatest, thumbs up for everything but unfortunately the margarita wasn't the greatest
Nice afternoon spot for a cold beer and to people watch. Great draft beer selection! Friendly wait staff. Collin did an outstanding job!

I had the encrusted Grouper and she had the pesto shrimp pasta. Both were really good. The atmosphere is comfortable casual but was a lil noisy, considering only 1/2 the restaurant was full but overall, we enjoyed the meals. Certainly a place to go if you're looking for top quality food that's not the norm.

Came here for breakfast. All i tried was the breakfast platter. It was nothing to phone home about. Its a decent sized portion, but the flavors are only meh. The shrimp was well cooked but batter on it and the soft shell crab is just ok. Poached eggs and sauce are standard and the canadian bacon lent nothing to this dish. All very meh, but the ambience is nice.

Pizza aside, I surprised to see two workers not wearing gloves when the were handling f. The second person in the expo line (adding extra toppings) took his gloves off and only put them back on a couple of pizzas later. The person working the cash went from handling money and wiping her nose to handling salad toppings. She did put gloves on for the pizza toppings but would stick ungloved hands into the salad toppings right after handling money and touching her face.

Update: staff still don't wear gloves. A staff member was cutting produce, wiped her nose, and went right back to touching the food. Another staff member was not using gloves (or washed his hands) when handling pizzas. Very unimpressed.

We were in the area from Chester County, PA doing some outlet shopping when we stopped in for lunch and it did not disappoint. Highly recommend their brick oven pizzas and garlic knots. Everything tasted so fresh and service was very prompt. We've already decided this will not be our only visit to Benny's. AMAZING

I absolutely love coming to this place! It's a very small hidden gem right off Gulf Boulevard in Saint Petersburg beach. If you want to get seated right away make sure you arrive at least by 6 PM. Other than that it could be anywhere between a 20 to 30 minute wait. There's only about 10 tables in the restaurant. I totally see what all the hype is about! The steaks are to die for! At a reasonable price! The onion straws and fries are also pretty darn good. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a casual but high-end tasting steak house!

We actually drove to this area a while back to try Renaud's next door. We had our pup with us so we were specifically looking for a place with outdoor seating. After sitting down, we reviewed the menu and nothing looked too appetizing, so my husband checked out Harry's Menu online and we both found something we were looking for. We moved from Renaud's outdoor seating to a general table across the plaza and my husband went inside to order. He said the staff was friendly and professional and that the interior had a dark, classy feel that would be great for a date night. He also remarked on the nice bar.
He brought the food out to me in the to-go containers and we had a makeshift picnic right there. He enjoyed his sandwich and our pup had no complaints about the fries. My mud pie was delicious! We would definitely go back for a dine in experience...hopefully post-covid...when we are in the area again.

The owner is nice and is happy to answer questions on what's good. 

I asked what was the best thing to try and was told the eggplant chaat roll is what I should try but ran out so I went with the lamb.  I love lamb and this was a good choice.  

Good bite with slight crunch with the veggies and this is worth checking out. 

I'll have to come back for the other rolls

Came here for dinner with my family and had a great experience. Staff was friendly, efficient and knowledgeable. Got the fried chicken which was a generous but delicious portion. The ambience and industrial interior design at 5th and Taylor sets the tone for a classy but relaxed dinner vibe that makes for a great night out.

Super cool little spot with covered seating as well as uncovered. The coffee is some of the best I've had in St Pete. My husband had an omelette that he said was delicious! I had avocado toast which is just sliced avocado on a piece bread but still somehow really good. I will definitely be back for the coffee!!

This is, by far, the best restaurant in St. Charles. Every time I've come the service has been impeccable and the food amazing. Today, however, we did not have very good service. I'm not typically one to say anything but because we had brought our family and had expected what we've become accustomed to as far as service at Prasino, I decided to just check in with someone at the front. I spoke with someone named Channing (sp?) and within moments, she turned our experience around. She made sure we had the drinks we were waiting on and ensured the manager brought our entrees out. I am so grateful to places like Prasino that take their guests' experiences so seriously. For parents who rarely get to go out, dining out is a treat and to experience service that resembles the kind you might have at a Denny's after a huge drinking day in the city (think Mardi Gras) makes you wish you would've just stayed home. Thank you Prasino for never disappointing us and especially Channing for doing an amazing job at keeping the bar high in terms of customer service. We will be back, of course!
Such a fabulous restaurant and amazing prices! Quality fish and great service. We loved the soup, our rolls were great and couldn't believe how cheap it was! We will be back!!

I got la nonna (grandma pie) pizza and it was incredible. Square cut and full of flavor. I love how you can see the garlic pieces that were sliced thin. The sauce and crust were amazing and I really enjoyed the flavor of the olive oil they drizzled on the pie. Can't wait to order it again!

Good day to be the cheesesteak guy.  Great little place.  Unfortunately the cheesesteak was the weak link.  Great family run business with Grandma and dad pics on the wall.  They support other local business' ie. Fireman donuts.  which were good and made by a fireman.  Lettuce and Tomato may have ruined this cheesesteak.  The meat needed to be on this big bready roll and not on top of the lettuce and Tomato.  Overall it was a great experience.

I want to like it here. I really, really do. They have fantastic drinks, great service and I love the atmosphere. Not to mention, they are super close to home for me. But their food sucks. Bland, unseasoned, boring. It is beautifully presented, everything looks fresh and nice but it just...sucks.  The hot wings were the only redeeming thing out of our dinner. Hubby ordered the chicken sandwich, it sounded delicious and it arrived looking fantastic and super crispy. Unfortunately it had zero flavour. He wasn't looking for 11 herbs and spices, just 2. Salt and pepper. The fries even sucked, they were soggy and totally undercooked and the gravy was gross. How do you f up fries? I had the poke tuna bowl and it was boring and bland. Anything would have helped it. Our server was great, drinks were very good, everything was hot and arrived fast, restaurant was clean and comfortable. We just won't be back for shitty, mediocre food. I tried.

The worst club to hit in down town. Yea it's on the main avenue but a dress code for the public? How inconsiderate and annoying. Joggers that well look like the shaggy sweats that the employees wear. Everyone is too messed up to even notice people who wear joggers unless you work at fashion nova. I thought this was a club. I am NEVER going to spend my well earn money to step in for 20 dollars a piece when beer and tips can be spent. I hope this place goes out of business and better bar replaces it. what a bad name for Tucson
Staff's a little snooty and it's pricey BUT, food is fresh and good. Great selection of veggies and other add one, nice atmosphere- now if the manager didn't tie up one of the booths as his office...

So glad we finally tried this place! They will deliver if you live within 1 mi. You just go to their website, look at the menu and call them. I paid over the phone and it was delivered fresh to my front porch. The man who took my order was so friendly and was also the one who delivered. He wore his mask and we were able to maintain a safe distance when he dropped the food off. Everything was delicious! Fresh, crispy tortilla chips, homemade regular and tomatillo salsas, queso drip, chicken quesadilla, and shrimp tacos hit the spot. Their corn tortillas are some of the best I've had. Their rice and beans are better quality and fresher tasting than many other Mexican restaurants I have been to. Even though it was takeout, it was still nicely presented in the containers. Can't wait to try more items on their menu! I believe after 6/1 they are looking to do some sort of automated ordering for delivery, but it wasn't a problem just calling them directly.

Great place. Ordered an oat milk cappuccino, which exceeded my expectations. The espresso was full of flavor and just the right amount of milk.  The service was great and fast given how many people were there. 

Also ordered the avocado toast, which is the reason I couldn't give it a 5. The bread was delicious, a thick honey oat type of bread and toasted perfect. The avocado had a bit too much olive oil. Could of used a tad bit of salt.

My husband and I went here for a date night, and it was amazing! I had the surf and turf... filet mignon and lobster tail. It was done to perfection. The lobster tail was massive! My husband had the 14oz ribeye, potatoes au gratin, and a Caesar salad, all of which were exceptionally good! We shared a side of Mac and cheese, and it was also delectable. We will definitely be coming here again and highly recommend!!

Where should I start... first off the theater smells like mildew. The seats have stains all over them. We went to watch a movie while visiting some friends in Tampa. The power cut off five minutes into the movie. They had just sitting with emergency lights on for 3-7 minutes then some guy walks in (not an employee) and is like their evacuating everyone. My dates food hits the floor because now people are rushing and shuffling. We get outside to a long line where everyone is waiting for a refund (so we thought) when we get to the front their giving out rain check tickets. First off I'm not from Tampa Wesley Chapel whatever, I was just visiting a friend and we had a spontaneous let's go to the movies thought. Secondly, we waited to talk to Phil B who is the asst manager for a refund. When he finally gets to us he's like I'm very sorry I would give you a refund but there's no power to give you a refund. He then says "I'm gonna get you a card from my office and call me I'll refund you tomorrow. I'm like cool at this point. We don't take the blue purple green whatever the tickets were we just bounce (leave). Fast forward we call Phil B straight to vm for an hour or two. I call fandango who I'm gonna leave a review on next and tell them the situation. They call Phil B and he says naw no refund we phil said he gave everyone tickets for the rain check. Phil is a liar.  CinéBistro is not worth the headache cold food or poor customer service I'm not sure if the other locations are bett
The calamari sandwich was surprisingly good.  Calamari was grilled and very tender.  I had the Cobb salad which was very nicely dressed with the house made vinaigrette.  Very good prices too.

I like everything about this Panera, but the music. The music station chosen is quite terrible! I would go here more, if the music were better. Pleasssse pick another station! 
People are friendly though and dining room is nice.

I was really excited to go to Milk and Honey during a trip to Nashville...the location is great because it's in the center of a lot of cool shops and street art. The food wasn't anything special though...I had a biscuit sandwich with fried chicken, an egg and cheese that came with a side of home fries that was OK but tasted a little too dry and not flavorful enough for my liking. Also--be prepared to wait! On a Sunday morning we waited for about an hour before getting a table. They do use an app where you can see where you are in line though which is nice and it did seem like the line was moving pretty fast.
Food was delish. Could use a little direction on how much spices to add. Years ago they gave you guidelines. Lots of options.

Zero stars.. i might as well be broke as I carry nothing but 100$ bills and can't afford these garbage ass fast food places. Another place that I can't dine at forever! Bye bye chic fila you guys are awful
Great location. Dog friendly, the brought his own water bowl.  Great food.  Tons of options from lunch to dinner. We had pizza, club sandwich and ceasar salad.  Service was great. Love this place.

We tried this place for the first time today and lemme tell ya man, I wish we woulda visited this place sooner.
It's not a very big place, it's a deli, Italian grocery store and small small restaurant in one building. I was amazed with the selection of take home fresh and frozen meals that are available for take home meals.
We stopped here to try authentic Italian food and they didn't disappoint. My wife had the chicken parmesan with spaghetti and I ordered ravioli stuffed with shrimp served with a cream sauce. The marinara sauce on the chicken parmesan was two thumbs up. My wife was happy with her meal and I was also impressed with the ravioli shrimp.
The only downside is that they sell refrigerated canned sodas and bottled teas but they don't have ice to enjoy our drinks. That won't make me knock them down from 5 stars.
I highly recommend this quaint place!

This spot is really good for those who want to eat outside during Covid! Their inside is open with the windows down too! The waitresses here are always so sweet and the service overall is always really professional. I love that the food always comes out quickly and hot. The food is delicious and very much plentiful!
Always love my food when I order from here. Highly recommend the Crab Balls and fried Red Fish. Also their lunch salads are the size of the dinner salads. All great choices.

This is my go to place to eat in this area. First off, the food is so good. It is better pizza than the other places nearby for sure. The menu is huge and there are so many options for whatever I'm in the mood for. They also have really delicious cake slices/ water ice too. Also, the prices are really good- there is a ton of food for a really great price. I'm always surprised at how little I have to pay. It is always clean and the service is attentive and friendly. I am always helped right when I come in and all the employees are super nice. Lastly, I am on a school sports team and this is our favorite place to come all together. We come in with a huge group and we are always get great food and service and this place is special for us. We love Venice, it's our spot! I would recommend this place to others for sure.

I had a lovely dinner tonight at The Eagle, I have been there a few times but this time I had the pleasure of having a amazing an attentive server that knew her stuff. Erin did a incredible job in ensuring that my experience at the eagle was better then all the others that I have had there. She gave excellent recommendations such as the Eagle Iced Tea, their version of a Long Island, as well as a delicious shrimp po boy. I will definitely be coming back here thanks to Erin, she did amazing! Definitely come here to eat and I hope that you have such a great experience as I had. Thanks again for making my night Erin!

This place was suggested to us by our concierge at the Marriott New Orleans and by a family friend. We walked in and were sat quickly. Our server was super nice and did an awesome job managing his section. I wish I remembered his name. Our drinks were always full, and our food was rolling out quickly. We had a mix of appetizers to try all the things. We had a dozen chargrilled oysters, bbq shrimp, and the gumbo trio.

Chargrilled oysters. Oh yes. Deanies vs Acme. These were two chargrilled oyster places we were told to test. Verdict. Slightly different. Both great. Deenies are cheesier and buttery. At Acme you are definitely going to taste more of the oyster. Still cheesy and buttery, but more apparent that you are eating an oyster. We tried out both places to determine a chargrilled oyster place for an upcoming bachelor party. My partner has decided on Deenies. Much easier to get in and out and thinks the boys will prefer the cheesier oysters! I also loved dipping my bread into that garlic butter goodness at the bottom of the pan. Damn good. 

BBQ shrimp. You have to peel them yourself and they come with the head on, but our server let us know before hand. Thank you. This was not what I was expected. I was envisioning a thick bbq sauce. It was not. More of an oil based sauced flavored with bbq...idk hard to explain. It was tasty, but just not the bbq sauce I'm used to. 

Soup Trio. We had the seafood gumbo, the sausage gumbo, and the crawfish etoufee. We didn't paticulary lo

Months ago we tried to go to their location on houghton but it was insanely crowded with people competing for the self seating tables. That gives me anxiety, so we left, sad, as the menu looked amazing. So I was very excited when the large speedway location opened. 

We went for lunch on a weekend, right around 12:30 and seating was plentiful, including a nice outdoor area. You order at counter and they bring to you. It takes a bit to get your food, but that's cause they don't start till you order, including for the pizza slices.

And I say slices, because even though it says pizza slice, you get two huge slices. They said it was on par with a Costco slice, but I say it was bigger.

The husbands phillie was so good he said it was one of his top. I thoroughly enjoyed the potato salad, which had lots of fresh herbs you could taste. Delicious.

To my brother and I , this is the best buffet ever!!!.
We went on a Saturday for lunch and everything was delicious excellent, well prepared and delicious!   I can't wait to go back
Super cute and yummy! They also sell funny shirts. The woodwork is beautiful and there's a really homey vibe. The employees are kind and friendly.

My boyfriend and I just went to Livery for the first time this evening. All I can says is, WOW! Not only is the environment perfect, but the service was outstanding, and the food was TO DIE FOR! We had the taquitos, ceviche, corn empanadas, steak empanadas, and chocolate flan. The steak empanadas had to be the best thing I've eaten this year! The only thing I'm upset about is the fact that I've been depriving myself of this incredible restaurant for way too long! This place is now at the top of my list. Thank you for a great first experience!

My family and I have been eating at Hymies for 30 years. The food and staff have been for the most part consistently good.

Nick, the manager is the only issue with this restaurant.

Today like we do on most weekends, we ordered over $100 of food and paid for it over the phone for takeout.

The main element of our large breakfast order was lox and bagels. The lox was unfortunately not in our bag despite it being the first item on the receipt and paid for. Hymies is a 30 minute drive each way for my family.

When we got home and realized that the main element of our breakfast was not there, we called and spoke to the general manager Nick. After politely explaining what happened, Nick argued with us stating that he wasn't sure if we had paid for it or not and told us to go over all twenty items in our bag and our receipt to determine whether or not it had been paid for.

I told him that I had five hungry family members waiting to eat and that it was not about the money, it was about the inconvenience.

Nick proceeded to offer no resolution and hang up
on us multiple times.

We then asked to speak to an owner or to put in a request to have an owner reach back out to us. Nick denied this request multiple times.

Because of Nick the manager, our 30 years of loyal weekly family patronage at Hymies has come to an end today, over 1/2 a pound of lox.

There are other local delicatessens that are equally as good and equally priced.

Message to the owner, if you see this and would like

I am not sure if they have new ownership but I have to say this was the worst food ever - we had 4 sushi rolls - the fish was mushy and probably old. The one roll had lettuce sticking out of it with maybe a sliver of fish. The hot and sour soup had no flavor and tasted like they dumped duck sauce in it. Very thick and again no flavor what so ever.  The Hunan beef was bland  no flavor at all - a little better once we added sesame oil and pepper sauce.
I will never go back - I ripped up our menus when we threw our our dinners.

Very disappointing - I ordered the pulled chicken and it was so salty, I couldn't wait to put the barbecue sauce on it to try to cover it up! I would have given one star but the fries were good and the staff were very nice.

Went here with my family tonight, great service! Nice, friendly staff who really knew their stuff. They were able to explain the food to us so we knew what we were getting. Best grouper sandwich, also tasty shrimp. Nice atmosphere even during covid. Would recommend for great food at decent prices!

We stopped in for lunch.  My wife had the brisket tacos.  I had the pulled pork and brisket combination plate.  Their sauce (3 different kinds) hot, sweet and Carolina were all good.  The BBQ was some of the best we've had.  We'll definitely be going back.

The best steak house in St. Pete FL! We have NEVER been disappointed! The best Drinks In St. Pete! Best food, only a little better than our own home cooking! We expect the best, and Beau & Mo's doesn't disappoint! I have no idea how they age their meat, but it's fantastic! You're stupid if you pass this awesome restaurant up! But we won't mind if you choose another restaurant, because you will miss the best gem of St. Pete!
I would give them more stars if I could! Best white pizza ever!! Nice atmosphere, great staff and a nice little gelato desert.
Today I went and got a roast beef sandwich and Juan did an awesome job on it. He gave me wonderful customer service as everyone who works there I appreciate it will be back Friday

An excellent meal in a cool, modern atmosphere.

In town for a meeting, my colleague and I walked in with no reservation on a Wednesday nite. We were seated immediately.  It's a large rectangular room with very high ceilings. Decor is stark, modern industrial with pillars of polished concrete and subdued lighting.  Tables are spaced fairly closely but care in design was taken to ensure that the acoustics are not loud. It was easy to carry on a conversation.

Our server, Zach, did a great job.  He walked us thru the menu, provided a few recommendations with detailed descriptions and assured us on portion sizes, with charm and a smile. He orchestrated the meal with great timing and kept our glasses filled and plates removed professionally and unobtrusively.  Thank you!

For appetizers we tried the Etch salad and the shrimp and octopus bruschetta.

The bruschetta is halved shrimp and thin sliced octopus atop crispy bread slathered with sunflower seed hummus, dressed with an arugula salad tossed with bacon, roasted tomato and capers, tossed in garlic oil and crumbles of manchego cheese.  Unexpectedly the shrimp and octopus are served warm (I would have expected chilled). I wouldn't describe this as particularly bruschetta-like but it was absolutely delicious. 

The Etch salad is an arugula and radicchio mix, tossed with fennel, green apple, blue cheese, hazelnuts and dressed with a delicious champagne vinaigrette.  The vinaigrette makes the meal, the champagne adding sweetness to

Admittedly, I've never eaten at a Sizzler..  but our family, on the 12 hour drive home, decided to stop and grab dinner.  Could not be happier!  First thing I see upon walking in is a happy hostess who was extremely nice and at the salad bar an employee very nicely asking a patron to wear a mask...  not judgmentally nor rudely, but in a way where everyone was smiling and went about their way.  We opted to sit outside (they have outside seating) and our waitress was very nice and helpful and the food was delicious and a great value...  I had the trio, kids had steak bites, and my wife had hibachi combo...  all was wonderful.  Great experience.

Overall very good food and service. Good new renovations. 

We are vegetarian. 
Chips and salsas included were nice. Salsa was spicy (green) and smokey (red). And chips were warm. 

Their margaritas were very tasty. We got the spicy and mango ones. 

Got the tacos with beans as well as the one with cauliflower. Cauliflower was nice and crispy. The beans was mashed and mixed well together - really recommend these. 

We also got 3 verde enchiladas but with cheese rather than chicken. It was oddly too sour. Unsure if off-day for them or normal recipe but it was way too sour.

The service at this location was horrendous! My niece placed 5 orders (1 for each of us at the house) using the app to take advantage of the Black Friday special to get a $5 gift card for each order. When she went in to pick up the orders, the women working accused her of lying that the order was for other people, called her names, made her wait for over 30 minutes, and would only give her one of the gift cards. I went into the store after my niece relayed to me how she was mistreated, and asked for the manager. The woman said she was the manager. I asked why they were rude to a young woman, they denied being rude. She gave me the other 4 gift cards but refused to explain their behavior, only stating something about "corporate policy". I can't imagine corporate policy permits the staff to be mistreat customers in this manner.

I'm so happy we found this location! We were about to drive all the way to Wesley Chapel location just to wait in line for probably an hour and realized there was the Fowler location close by, first off our server Jamie was SO SWEET !! I can't wait to come back and ask for her, she helped me out with finding the perfect order and was very patient and Fun ! We are a silly group so it was nice to have an easy going person wait on us, definitely an awesome and professional server  GO ASK FOR JAMIE !! But second of all.. the FOOD WAS YUMMY ! Didn't have to complain at all everything was hot and quick to come out . FIVE STARS !! I WOULD DEFINITELY RECOMMEND FIRST WTACH AT THE FOWLER LOCATION . Thanks again for your amazing service Jamie made a couple first timers feel right at home !
Great store with nice selections. Prices are high on a lot of items, though. Clean store and friendly staff.

Beautiful New Mexican Restaurant, great bar, loved the tequila drinks, but food was just okay. They should use better chips for the nachos, the ones used were soggy and didn't taste like much. We had a large group with us who all made the trip up from Southern DE to check it out. Everyone agreed great atmosphere, subpar food.

Menu wasn't updated online and they called and got mad at me about it.  I tried to replace an item and the woman said that the driver already left.  I ordered chicken for salad, and lamb for a sandwich, was not given either.  Awful.  Never returning.

When I visited Bovaconti this weekend, I realized I hadn't yet had an opportunity to review it. This coffee (and light snack) shop located in the heart of Fountain Square is a delicious spot to stop and warm up. From their deliciously crafted beverages to their amazing treats, this is one of my favorites spots in Indy. They always keep some of my favorite 4 Birds Bakery cookies as well (a great addition to my morning coffee). They also have a small retail space that includes beautiful cups and other items for purchase. 

This most recent visit my husband ordered the Cafe Miel (delightful, not too sweet, and great for warming up on a chilly day). I ordered the Honey Lavender Latte, iced. Even when it's cold, I frequently enjoy icy coffee drinks! The honey lavender latte did not disappoint! It's quite a bit sweeter than the cafe miel and has a distinct floral flavor. You can really taste the lavender (one of my favorite flavors). This is one my favorite drinks here; however I was also tempted by their seasonal selection. Next time, I will try one of their ice tea and lemonade options (sounds perfect for the spring time!)

During current conditions, this appears to be a carry-out only spot. They had individually sealed masks at the door and a sign limiting the number of individuals ordering at a time.

Past reviews for Yen Ching are very mixed, and after eating here I can see why. It seems hit or miss whether or not you will get good food.

My family ordered takeout from Yen Ching recently and our reactions ranged from unimpressed to downright disappointed. I ordered the steamed bao for my two-year-old, expecting some kind of pork buns, but instead these "bao" looked and tasted like potstickers that you would find in the frozen section at Costco.

I ordered the Spicy Thai Chicken Noodle after reading some good reviews for it here on Yelp, but that was possibly a mistake since Yen Ching is a Chinese restaurant, not Thai. The "Spicy" Thai Chicken Noodle was not the least bit spicy, and I'm one of those people who finds sriracha sauce a bit spicy. Instead of anything remotely resembling a spicy Thai dish, I received grilled chicken in a flavorless brown sauce with noodles, bell peppers, and onions.

I hope others have better experiences than we did, but the food we received from Yen Ching was not good and it was actually kind of confusing about how different our dishes were from what they should have been. Definitely won't be eating here again.

I loved everything about this restaurant. We first sat at the bar and listened to great piano player. We were then brought downstairs when our table was ready. It is so quaint downstairs, very romantic for a date night. The service and the food were fantastic.

See picture, they wouldn't even let me say this with the picture. Supposed to have butter and hash brown with the Big Breakfast,not ketchup and more salt.Thats what happens when they're playing around inside.
We went here for our date night and loved it. Feels like a special night out and the seafood is the best.  Chris Vtrainers Personal Training Studios
Love this place! Can't beat the happy hour, all of this yummy food and wine for $9!  Great waitstaff & a very relaxing atmosphere.

Glad this place is still going despite opening right at the beginning of Covid. I had heard of this place from multiple pasta snob friends and was glad to try it out. 

For drinks we got a couple of the spritz which honestly depending on how you like your alcohol, you could barely taste the alcohol. They were delicious though especially the melone. 

The focaccia was amazing and definitely a to get. I kinda wish we got two haha and the butter that came with it was divine. 

Pasta, we got the garganelli, gramigna, agnolotti, and the pappardelle. Pretty much all the meat ones and the agnolotti which was corn and black truffle. 

All the pastas were good, but I will say that I wish the pasta came out hotter. They were more on the side of luke warm to cooled so the texture of the pasta wasn't as nice once it got to our table. 

Since competition is super crazy in the city especially for pasta you gotta watch for anything you can make better.

First visit and I like the $2.00 all day specials, Landshark 16 oz for $2.00! 
Menu looks like decent bar food , wings , burgers and sandwiches. 
I like the bar atmosphere and will update the review after I try some food!

I've only been to Alena's Cafe twice and each time I've ordered the Chicken Club Sandwich... which hasn't disappointed! The sandwich is also really filling, I've only been able to eat half in one sitting. Also, I really want to try their baked good so I plan do get something sweet my next visit. 

Customer service has been great each time, from ordering over the phone to pick up. If you're looking for a small, black-owned business in Mt. Airy with good food, check out Alena's Cafe!
This place is great!!! It's always open when it sassy (unlike the Hillsboro McDonalds). It's clean, fast, and friendly!

Gluten free pancakes are a win!! Super good flavor, consistency, generous portion, and overall appeal! Been a big fan of Terri's cafe (formerly Steve's). I wish they had gluten free toast too. Overall my meal was hot, out quick, and cooked perfectly!
Love the Ice Cream. If you are looking for some wild flavored ice cream then this is the place to be going.
Good servers, good deals and lots of sports, but the music is loud and crazy (do we really want to listen to screaming while we eat?), and the thermostat seems to be set at 40 degrees.

Love, love, love this place! We have ordered a variety of different items from their menu and everything is great! Always great service too! So many different things on the TVs to watch, something for everyone, and great music videos. This place is a bit loud but we don't mind since we have young kids we don't have to worry about noise level we can just enjoy our meal as a family and have a good time.  Favorites: chicken nachos, pizza, wings, salad with potato straws, burgers, fries (don't forget the Bubbas sauce), ice cold beer

This is the worst Chick-fil-a around! My coworkers and I only come here out of convenience because our office is 5 minutes away. Line is always long and angry people are constantly cutting off your spot in line or beeping their horn. 

No matter what you order I guarantee it will be overcooked and tough. Black, burnt edges and rough meat that you need a power tool to cut into. Fries are always cold and half filled. 

The lemonade is always off too, once it was so sugary I couldn't even finish it, and now today I was drinking it when I swallowed some hard piece of lemon? I opened the cup to discover it basically filled with hard, weird pieces of pulp. Gross!
Good service and great food.  Mom has the cinnamon roll French toast and I had the eggs Benedict.  Food was packaged very well and was very tasty.  Good place to go for brunch.

Sigh, I was really looking forward to this place, especially since they have 4.5 stars!! The food was seasonLESS. It was like they had the right base for something that could be good.. The plate was beautiful but there was no flavor. I had the pork belly benedict (they forgot the pork belly) and besides for the biscuit base, everything else was pretty disappointing. The potatoes were bland. The bacon gouda grits were basically $9 grits w one strip of bacon torn on top.. coffee also wasn't great. Despite this, I will say the interior was beautiful. My mom was not satisfied either but I might give it one more try.

Hidden gem in Indy of Italian. Extra tables and tents are set up in the parking lot for more outside seating which was really nice. Great service and don't forget to get a great cocktail!
- Carpaccio, $18: Thin sliced beef tenderloin served with chives, truffle oil, pine nuts, shaved parmesan cheese, arugula and lemon.
-Linguine alla Vongole, $22.00:
Fresh Little Neck Clams, linguine, sauteéd in olive oil, garlic In white wine
-Veal special with potatoes and steamed veggies
BEST Brunch EVER today. Food was Great, service was Great and they let the 5 of us visit together after the meal...Awesome time spent together

I was so disappointed, I went in there with my daughter at 2:50pm on a Saturday. We go up to hostess stand and she walked right past us and went behind the coffee counter... we waited.... a guy behind the counter nudged her, "have you helped them?" As if I can't hear them.... "oh, we stopped making food at 2." I'm ok (ish) with the kitchen being closed but to blatantly disregard myself and my daughter was very poor customer service. Needless to say, I will not be back to try again. I work in customer service.... this is not how you treat people! So I politely said thank you and walked out, because I will still treat a human fairly.

Great food and exellent service.
Good looking girls always at the bar.
I'm looking forward to comback this Friday for the happy hour.

I'd strongly recommend avoiding this place. Was in yesterday (7/1/20) for lunch and, of the three employees, none were wearing masks. (One employee had it covering her chin). One sneeze or cough on the food, and dozens of customers could get infected. Compared to other restaurants, this QDOBA is lacking enforcement of critical operational policies at the company and state level.
Love this place, most delicious rice on the planet, lovely yummy platters and great atmosphere for affordable price.  Hoping to be able to order delivery from them online.
Nicely priced lunch specials. I got 3 rolls, miso soup and salad for $13. The sushi was super fresh. Definitely recommend.
